question_text: Find the number of 4-letter words that can be formed using the letters of the word PISTON in which at least one letter is repeated.

mark_split.label: Subtract to get at least one repeat

recall_prompt: Say how you would count the four-letter words from PISTON with at least one repeated letter — what you count first, what you count next, and why you subtract.
insider_note: "At least one letter repeated" is counted by subtraction: all words 6⁴ minus the no-repeat words ⁶P₄. Two of the four marks sit on the subtraction step, so say in words what is taken from what — the bare line 1296 − 360 is not the full step.

steps.label: Words with repetition allowed
steps.margin_note: First mark. PISTON has 6 different letters. With repetition allowed each of the 4 positions has 6 choices: 6⁴.

recall.must_convey: That with repetition allowed each of the four positions takes any of the six letters, giving 6 to the power 4 = 1296.
accept: with repetition each place has six choices so six to the power four which is one thousand two hundred ninety six
six to the four is twelve ninety six words in all
n to the r, six to the four
repetition allow chesthe prathi place ki six choices, six power four twelve ninety six
six times six times six times six
heard_as: one thousand two hundred ninety six

steps.why: "At least one repeat" is hard to count directly because a word may repeat one letter, two letters, or one letter three times. Counting ALL words first is the method that avoids it.
common_mistakes: Using ⁶P₄ or ⁶C₄ here — those exclude repeats.
Computing 4⁶ instead of 6⁴; the base is the number of letters, the power is the word length.

steps.label: Words with no letter repeated
steps.margin_note: Second mark. No letter repeated means an arrangement of 4 of the 6 letters: ⁶P₄ = 360.

recall.must_convey: That the words with no repeated letter are the arrangements 6 P 4 = 360.
accept: no repetition means six P four which is three hundred sixty
six times five times four times three is three sixty
the words with all letters different are six P four
repetition lekunda six P four three hundred sixty
arrangements of four out of six, three sixty

steps.why: Every word either has no repeated letter or has at least one, and never both. So the "no repeat" count is exactly what must be removed from the total.
common_mistakes: Using ⁶C₄ = 15 — a word is an arrangement, so order matters and it is ⁶P₄.

steps.label: Subtract
steps.margin_note: Two marks. All words minus words with no repeat: 1296 − 360 = 936.
lines: Words with at least one repeated letter
= all words − words with no repetition

recall.must_convey: That the words with at least one repeat are all words minus the words with no repeat, 1296 minus 360 = 936.
accept: at least one repeat is all words minus no repeat, twelve ninety six minus three sixty is nine hundred thirty six
subtract three sixty from twelve ninety six to get nine thirty six
the answer is nine hundred and thirty six

twelve ninety six minus three sixty

steps.why: The two sets in step 1 and step 2 differ exactly by the words with a repeat, so the subtraction is the count itself, not an estimate. This complement method is the standard way to count "at least one".
common_mistakes: Answering 360 — that is the count of words with NO repeat.
Writing the subtraction without the line that says what is being subtracted from what.
